title: Gear Ratio

reward.description: A twelve-toothed gear, polished to a mirror shine. Someone engraved 'G.R.' on the hub.

hints: The ratio is driven / driver. The driver is the gear the engine turns.
A small gear driving a big gear turns the big gear SLOWER: rpm * driver / driven.
For full_turns, // gives whole turns and % gives what's left over. Return both as a tuple: (turns, leftover).
